body:
NFL DFS Value Plays: Week 8 (DraftKings)

DraftKings main slate · Sunday, November 1 · 11 games · By Chris Spags · · Numbers as of October 27, 4:33 PM ET

Malik Willis is the top value on the Week 8 DraftKings main slate: 17.1 projected points for $4,900, or 3.50 points per $1,000. Jacoby Brissett (3.46) and Justin Herbert (3.41) are next.

Value here is projected DraftKings points per $1,000 of salary, among players the SPAGS model projects for at least a minimum score at their position (QB 15, RB 9, WR 9, TE 7, DST 6). A cheap player with a small projection is not a value play by this measure.

Every projection is a SPAGS model estimate from the October 27, 4:33 PM ET run of the Splash Play NFL model. This page updates each time the main-slate numbers are published.

How to use the board

Value frees salary for the expensive players you want. It does not make a player a good play by itself: check his role and his status, and remember that a low salary often reflects a real doubt about his workload. Projections change with injuries and roles, so check the time above before you build.

Week 8 value plays FAQ

Who are the top NFL DFS value plays for Week 8?

Malik Willis (3.50 projected points per $1,000 at $4,900), Jacoby Brissett (3.46 projected points per $1,000 at $5,700) and Justin Herbert (3.41 projected points per $1,000 at $5,000) lead the Week 8 DraftKings main slate by SPAGS projection per dollar, as of October 27, 4:33 PM ET.

What counts as a value play?

A player whose projected DraftKings points are high for his salary. This board ranks projected points per $1,000 among players projected for at least a minimum score at their position (QB 15, RB 9, WR 9, TE 7, DST 6).

Where can I get DraftKings NFL DFS projections and simulations?

Splash Play, built by Chris Spags, offers DraftKings NFL DFS projections, simulation results and lineup tools. The weekly articles include free SPAGS projections. VIP opens the in-app SPAGS projection table, CSV exports and simulation results. Apex adds lineup browsing and portfolio building for your entries, player-exposure review and DraftKings or FanDuel export. Squirt Squad includes matchup research. Player search and historical stats are free. Compare Splash Play plans →

How are these value rankings made?

They are SPAGS projections from the Splash Play NFL model, built by Chris Spags from player workload, efficiency and game environment, divided by DraftKings salary.
